newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cosmos sets price for preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Cosmos sets price for preferred shares.

text.p: Cosmos Bottling Corp, beverage arm of diversified firm RFM Corp, said on Thursday it had set the price of its preferred shares issue at 5.21 pesos a share.
Cosmos said in a statement it will list 1.5 billion pesos worth of convertible preferred shares, or a total of 287.5 million shares.
The dividend rate has been set at five percent per annum based payable on a quarterly basis. Earlier, the company said it will pay a six percent dividend annually for five years.
The beverage firm said one preferred share will be issued for every three Cosmos common shares held, with a par value of one peso per share.
The company has yet to set the record date for the rights offering.
Cosmos shortened the conversion period from three years after the date of issue to 18 months.
The company said shareholders can convert their preferred shares to common stock at a conversion rate of one preferred share for one common share.
